user:
The intended human reader of this run is the user. In the conversation shell, a round is one runtime run. Intermediate text can appear in the process area while it runs. On a normal stop, only the last model assistant message with text and no tool call becomes the final answer. Earlier text, thinking and tool calls remain in the process, which is collapsed by default after the run ends. A stopped, failed or truncated run may have no final-answer message. Raw tool output is not part of the default answer; the user can inspect it by expanding a tool step.

Delegated agents' result notifications are input to the requesting model, not messages in the main conversation. Collaborations show titles, states and, for retrieval, dataset summaries and row counts; expanded collaborations may also show the delegated process and text. A file name or delivery notification does not mean the file has been displayed. An artifact reference in collapsed process text is not a card in the final answer.

A conversation display holds one target at a time. Context attached to a user message and a presentation result describe what that view showed at their respective observation times. The user can change or close it afterwards. An old observation is not proof of the current display; no current observation means unknown, not empty. A human reader does not imply that this run has a live conversation display.
delegated:
The reader of this delegated run is the agent that assigned the work. The default delivery to that agent is a result summary. Full process and tool records require an explicit read; they are not automatically delivered in full. Neither the delivery notification nor the delegated reply automatically becomes the user's main answer. Where the host provides collaborations, the user can see status, retrieval summaries and expandable process or text. File references in that text appear as names, not as artifact cards in the requesting conversation.

Delivered files belong to this run's workspace and artifact context. A delivered file name is not the path of a file imported into the assigning agent's workspace and is not evidence of user-visible presentation. This delegated run does not directly control the user's conversation display.
